# Tuya Rental Nusa Penida

> Tuya Rental Nusa Penida is a premier tour operator and vehicle rental service in Nusa Penida, Bali, Indonesia. We offer private air-conditioned car tours, guided motorbike riding tours, and daily scooter rentals for tourists exploring Nusa Penida island.

## Key Offerings & Services

- **Private AC Car Tour (West Nusa Penida)**: IDR 750,000 / tour. Includes private car, driver, fuel, fastboat tickets from Sanur harbor, entrance fees, and lunch. Route: Kelingking Beach, Broken Beach, Angel's Billabong, Crystal Bay.
- **Private AC Car Tour (East Nusa Penida)**: IDR 800,000 / tour. Includes private car, driver, fuel, fastboat tickets from Sanur harbor, entrance fees, and lunch. Route: Diamond Beach, Atuh Beach, Thousand Islands Treehouse, Giri Putri Cave.
- **Guided Motorbike Tour (West Side Riding)**: IDR 350,000 / person. Guided motor tour exploring Kelingking Cliff & Broken Beach with local rider guide and SNI helmet.
- **Guided Motorbike Tour (East Side Riding)**: IDR 400,000 / person. Guided motor tour visiting Diamond Beach & Atuh Beach with local rider guide and SNI helmet.
- **Daily Scooter Rental (Honda Vario 125cc)**: IDR 150,000 / day. Includes 2 SNI helmets, raincoats, full tank starting fuel, 24/7 roadside assistance, and harbor delivery/pickup.
- **Daily Scooter Rental (Honda Scoopy 110cc)**: IDR 100,000 / day. Includes 2 stylish helmets, raincoat, top engine condition, and harbor delivery/pickup.

## Location & Contact Information

- **Brand Name**: Tuya Rental Nusa Penida (formerly Nusa Penida Motor Trip)
- **Primary Service Locations**: Toya Pakeh Harbor & Sanur Harbor, Bali, Indonesia
